summary: Snapshot only a user-supplied validated Repark marker window into the typed local store.
reason: A bare generated sync must not silently succeed without a provider request or select an implicit driver location. Explicit flags override a supplied REPARK_SYNC_RANGE; no window is preset. Preview resolves the same effective environment window before deciding whether required request parameters are present.
validated_outcome: Missing/oversized live windows and explicit invalid preview windows fail before IO. Environment-only dry-run reaches the source preview instead of skipping the resource. A bounded public window stores source rows and supports subsequent local search.
